page: Google Cloud Platform t2a-standard-8 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by an Ampere Altra ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores with 8 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 3.0 GHz with no hyperthreading. The hardware configuration includes 32 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Cache specifications consist of 64 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. This instance does not include local NVMe storage or bundled GPUs, and has zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data indicates average performance across several multi-threaded and memory-bound workloads. In stress-ng testing, the instance achieved a single-core score of 1812.89 and a multi-core score of 14472.4. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only small block cached speeds of 563.91 GB/sec, while uncached large block read and write speeds reach 87.42 GB/sec and 47.24 GB/sec respectively. The instance demonstrates average throughput in static web serving at 10.09 GB/sec and processes 10.91 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks.

The ARM64 architecture presents specific performance tradeoffs. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 1073.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 6205.54, both falling into the bottom 25% of tested servers. Cryptographic and vector processing limitations are present; the CPU lacks AVX, AVX-512, and AMX extensions, resulting in a weak Passmark CPU encryption test score of 1300.22. Additionally, LLM inference performance is poor, with text generation using a small 135M model limited to 32.29 tokens per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the t2a-standard-8 offers a balanced resource profile for ARM-native workloads without the overhead of hyperthreading. It is suitable for multi-threaded applications that scale across physical cores, such as software compilation, static web serving, and database operations. However, it is not recommended for single-threaded tasks, heavy cryptography, or machine learning inference.
description: Google Cloud Platform t2a-standard-8 is an ARM64-based general-purpose instance featuring 8 dedicated physical cores on an Ampere Altra Neoverse-N1 processor running at 3.0 GHz. Equipped with 32 GB of RAM and no local storage or GPU, this instance provides a balanced resource profile. Benchmark results show average performance in multi-threaded tasks, such as software compilation and static web serving, alongside a Redis SET throughput of 10.91 million operations per second. However, the platform exhibits weak single-core performance, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1073.0, and lacks advanced vector extensions, leading to lower efficiency in cryptographic and LLM inference workloads. It is best suited for scale-out workloads, web servers, and multi-threaded application hosting.
